summary: Canagold Resources filed a Form 6-K attaching two press releases, the primary one dated October 1, 2026, reporting assay results from five holes of a completed 14-hole, 7,277m infill and expansion drill program at the 100%-owned New Polaris gold project in northwestern British Columbia. Highlights include 3.83% Sb and 19.38 g/t Au over 13.20m, including 1.21m grading 30.46% Sb and 49.10 g/t Au. No transaction, corporate action, or special situation is disclosed; the filing is routine exploration disclosure with no deal terms.
